proposal.description: The combined converter enable g_en is registered instead of combinational, so the switch and host enables reach the gate drive and the FSM a clock late
proposal.reason: If en_SW or spi_enable falls in S_SS or S_RUN, en stays high for one more clock and the FSM registers S_OFF a clock late. A start from S_OFF also moves to S_SS a clock after the enable rises.

after: Drive the LM5106 enable. Gated by the fault inputs directly as well as by the

proposal.description: The LM5106 enable en is registered to give a glitch-free gate drive, so it follows the state and the fault inputs one clock late
proposal.reason: en rises one clock after the FSM registers S_SS. It stays high for one clock after S_RUN gives way to S_HICCUP on window_trip. After OTP, UVLO, latch_state, latch_assert or a disable, it drops a clock late instead of on the same clock.
